Import raw 990 governance fields via the panel990 package

Source: R/get-data.R
get_governance_data.Rd

Downloads the IRS efile tables that hold the governance and management fields (Form 990 Parts IV, VI, and XII and Schedule M), keeps the columns get_features needs, merges them into one row per filing, and drops 990EZ filers (who do not report these fields). The result is ready to pass to get_features.

Usage

get_governance_data(
  years,
  eins = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  cache = c("temporary", "retain"),
  path = "efdata",
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

years

Integer vector of tax years to import.

eins

Optional character vector of formatted EINs (EIN2, e.g. "EIN-43-2031361") to restrict the download to specific organizations.

source

A panel990::data_source() configuration. Defaults to the NCCS efile v2.1 archive. Point root at a local directory to read already-downloaded tables.

cache

Passed to panel990::download_tables(): "temporary" (default) uses a session temp directory; "retain" keeps a durable cache in path.

path

Cache directory used when cache = "retain".

verbose

Print panel990 progress messages.

Value

A data.frame with one row per filing containing ORG_EIN, the raw governance fields, and identifier columns, ready for get_features.

Details

Retrieval is delegated to the panel990 package, which must be installed: remotes::install_github("Nonprofit-Open-Data-Collective/panel990").

See also

get_features, get_scores, get_governance_scores.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dat <- get_governance_data(years = 2022)
features <- get_features(dat)
scores <- get_scores(features)
} # }
